verdict.headline: Tata Consultancy Services shows steady growth but faces challenges in achieving margin targets.

narrative_vs_numbers.text: Management's narrative of growth momentum is supported by the reported 11.2% year-on-year revenue growth in the latest quarter. However, the operating margin target of 25% plus was not met, indicating a gap between aspirations and current performance.

bull.text: TCS achieved a significant year-on-year revenue growth of 11.2% in the latest quarter, indicating strong demand.
The company has a stable debt-to-equity ratio of 0.1, reflecting a strong balance sheet.
Free cash flow was substantial at ₹48,013 Cr in FY26, supporting the company's commitment to return cash to shareholders.

bear.text: Operating margin did not reach the 25% plus target, remaining at 26% in the latest quarter.
Total borrowings increased significantly to ₹11,808 Cr by Sep 2026, which could impact financial flexibility.
Debtor days increased to 93 days in FY26, indicating potential challenges in cash collection.
